messages.subject: MCDS automation with python
parts:
Hello all.
As I'm about to close all my gmail accounts, I'd like to give you through this last message the link to my work on this subject : look for pyaudisam at github :-)
It's not ready for use, because it lacks:
* a few things for direct python scripting,
* and a good quick start documentation with real life data exemples.
But there's already an (alpha stage) module published on pypi.
And I'm working on fixing what's missing, need for some more months :-)
See you on github if you're interested !
(and never more here)
Bye.
Jean-Philippe (mobile).
